system.description:
A master of Animalism rules not only lesser creatures but the monster within, holding the reins of his own Beast with a discipline lesser Kindred can only envy.

You may enter a controlled frenzy at will by winning or tying a Simple Test, choosing your own targets while the frenzy otherwise runs its normal course; failure instead plunges you into an ordinary uncontrolled frenzy. You may also claw back composure during an uncontrolled frenzy by winning a Self-Control Challenge, then spending one Willpower Trait each turn to hold that control until your Willpower runs out or the frenzy ends normally.
